description: Sim-to-real in-context generative formulation-design pipeline, audited. See MODEL_CARD.md: the central protein-conditional claim is not supported by evidence collected so far; the verified finding is that in-context conditioning requires in-context-structured pretraining (p=0.0039).

checkpoint_icl_best.pt.description: Pretrained on in-context-structured sequences (K example pairs + query)

checkpoint_conditional_best.pt.description: Pretrained on flat (protein, recipe, outcome) triples only, same corpus otherwise

training.loss: joint next-recipe-token CE (masked to simulator-preferred rows) + stability-bin CE
training.hardware: RTX 3050 (8GB) + 28-core CPU for parallel data generation

likelihood_percentile.caveat: unconditional (protein-blind) baseline scores higher (0.872); this metric alone does not evidence conditional knowledge

protein_specificity.caveat: the metric that isolates conditional knowledge; statistically indistinguishable from chance

icl_necessity_finding.metric: likelihood_percentile, with vs. without real in-context examples at inference
icl_necessity_finding.reproduction: rerun scripts/evaluate_real.py with --shots 2 vs --no-context for each checkpoint

intended_use.primary: Reference implementation of the sim-to-real + in-context architecture; demonstration of the ICL-training-necessity finding, independent of the formulation domain
intended_use.not_supported_yet: Generating formulations expected to be protein-specific; the evidence available does not support this use
intended_use.validation: Computational hypotheses only, not clinical or manufacturing recommendations

limitations: Protein descriptors are 3 quantized scalars (MW, pI, baseline Tm), not full sequence
A separate n=80 sequence-based analysis (BioFormBench-Marketed) also found no detectable protein effect on real marketed formulation choice
No wet-lab validation at any stage
Simulator v2 pathway weights are literature-informed, round numbers, not fit by optimization
